exposure.needed: which composition function invocations return an error because of an issue with the composite resource at runtime

consequence.statement: No operational consequence is stated: compose function error messages simply include expanded detail when there is an issue with the composite resource; nothing fails, is rejected, or stops being honoured.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 expands the error messaging emitted when a compose function encounters an issue with the composite resource.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
